# Preview and improve an Agent

# Preview and improve an Agent

Use the editor's preview area to review an Agent before you make it available to other people. A preview is most useful when you have a small, clear request and non-sensitive source material ready.

## Review the configuration

1. Open the Agent editor and read the name, description, instructions, data access, capabilities, and knowledge settings.
2. Open the preview panel and select **Preview**.
3. Check whether the Agent's purpose and expected result are clear.
4. In **Preview**, try a small request with information you are allowed to use.
5. Compare the result with the source and update one part of the configuration at a time.

If the result is too broad, narrow the instructions or data scope. If it misses information, check that the right knowledge source is available and that the Agent has permission to use it. If it proposes an action, require a confirmation step and verify the destination result separately.

## Improve deliberately

Change one variable at a time so you can tell what helped: the wording of an instruction, the expected output format, a knowledge source, or a capability. Keep examples short and avoid real customer or confidential data. Repeat the same kind of request after each change and keep the version that is easiest to review.

Previewing an Agent does not replace access review. Before sharing it, confirm the intended editors and users, then check the saved settings after the change. Continue with [Manage and share an Agent](/en/agents/manage-and-share/#manage-and-share-an-agent) when the configuration is ready.
